The title '''Deputy Undersecretary to the Assistant Chief Subcounsel of the Greater Caarimon Communications Division of the Caarimon Ministry of Conservation''' was held by [[Nuris Blaht]], a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Caarite]] who worked for the [[Caarimon Ministry of Conservation]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The role of the job was to greet all off-worlders who arrived on [[Caarimon]], the Caarite [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="BotB">{{LivingForce|Metatheran Caution: Belly of the Beaast}}</ref>
